title: Orchestrator Response Envelope
description: The single top-level object every engine invocation returns (FR-001/FR-002). Exactly one envelope, nothing outside it. Field order is canonical for determinism (FR-003).

status.description: ok = phase produced its payload; blocked = missing/malformed input or transient resource pause; needs_escalation = human handoff (FR-005, FR-025, FR-035).

payload.description: Phase-specific payload (see phaseN-*.schema.json). MUST be {} when status != ok (FR-005).

reasoning_log.description: Ordered decision trace; ALL justification lives here only (FR-004). Redacted before persistence (FR-038).

type.description: e.g. missing_input, contradictory_input, resource_unavailable, low_consensus, critical_failure.

transient.description: true => pause-and-resume, NOT a human escalation (FR-035). Resource exhaustion sets this true with status=blocked.
